explanation: The certificate arrived in time under § 4(1), but the physician examined the student only on Thursday, 22 July 2027, the day after the examination, and certifies unfitness from that day. The student's own report of a fever since 20 July 2027 does not replace an examination by the physician on or before the examination date, which § 4(2) requires. The illness is not accepted.

All four modules are listed in the learning agreement approved on 30 June 2026, before the stay began on 1 September 2026, and all were passed (10 or higher out of 20). Under § 7(3) Convex Optimization counts with at most the 6 credits of the module Optimization that it replaces, not with 8. The office recognizes 20 credits (6 + 6 + 5 + 3).

The IT service confirms that the portal account was blocked during the whole registration period (17 June 2027 to 1 July 2027), which would be a reason under § 2(3). However, § 2(2) allows late registration only until the seventh calendar day before the examination on Thursday, 15 July 2027, that is until 8 July 2027, and the request arrived on 9 July 2027. Late registration is denied.

The record shows two failed attempts (17 February 2026 and 16 February 2027); the examination of 20 July 2026 was cancelled for an accepted illness and does not count under § 5(2). The student therefore still has the third attempt, and the advisor's written confirmation of the counselling interview required by § 5(4) is attached. Registration for the third attempt on 20 July 2027 is granted, and one attempt remains.

The submission deadline was Friday, 11 June 2027, and the request arrived on Monday, 14 June 2027. Under § 6(4) a request must reach the examination office before the deadline, so the illness from 24 May 2027 to 4 June 2027 can no longer lead to an extension. The request is denied.

The request arrived on Tuesday, 13 July 2027, exactly the seventh calendar day before the examination on Tuesday, 20 July 2027, and the registration confirmation shows the second attempt. Under § 3(1) a student may withdraw without giving reasons until that day. The withdrawal is granted.

The student missed the examination on Monday, 12 July 2027 and sent the certificate on the next day, within the three working days of § 4(1). The physician examined the student on the examination date and certifies unfitness for examinations from 12 July 2027 to 14 July 2027, as § 4(2) requires. The illness is accepted.

The student attended a summer school abroad from 6 July 2026 to 24 July 2026 without a learning agreement. Under § 7(1) no credits are recognized without a learning agreement approved by the examination office before the stay began. The request is denied.

The IT service confirms a fault of the student's portal account from 18 June 2027 to 6 July 2027. The fault covers the whole registration period (21 June 2027 to 5 July 2027) and is a reason under § 2(3), and the request arrived on Monday, 12 July 2027, the seventh calendar day before the examination on Monday, 19 July 2027 and the last day § 2(2) allows. Late registration is granted.

The record shows two attempts that count under § 5(2): the failed examination of 18 February 2026 and the absence without an accepted reason on 23 July 2026. The examination on 22 July 2027 would therefore be the third attempt, and § 5(4) requires the advisor's written confirmation of a counselling interview, which is not attached. The registration is denied, and one attempt remains.

The supervisor confirms in writing that the industry partner delivered the sensor data on 22 March 2027 instead of 1 March 2027, a delay beyond the student's control under § 6(2). The request for three weeks arrived before the deadline of 4 June 2027 and stays within the six weeks of § 6(3). The new deadline is Friday, 25 June 2027.

All four modules are listed in the learning agreement approved on 20 November 2026, before the stay began on 22 February 2027. Under the transcript's grading scale (pass from 18 out of 30), Computer Graphics with 15 was not passed, so § 7(2) excludes it. The office recognizes 15 credits (6 + 3 + 6).

The request arrived on Wednesday, 21 July 2027, six days before the examination on Tuesday, 27 July 2027 and one day after the withdrawal without reasons of § 3(1) had ended (20 July 2027). The student gives no reason, so a withdrawal under § 3(2) is not possible either. The withdrawal is denied.

After the examination on Wednesday, 26 May 2027, the first three working days were 28 May 2027, 31 May 2027, and 1 June 2027, because 27 May 2027 was a public holiday in Hessen (Corpus Christi). The certificate arrived on Wednesday, 2 June 2027, the fourth working day, after the deadline of § 4(1). The illness is not accepted.

The registration period for the examination on Wednesday, 28 July 2027 ran from 30 June 2027 to 14 July 2027, and the certificate covers only 8 July 2027 to 16 July 2027. Under § 2(3) the reason must have prevented registration on every day of the registration period, and the student could have registered from 30 June 2027 to 7 July 2027. Late registration is denied.
